verification_report.summary: The full supplement passes sequential verification, conditional on the specified conclusions of divisorial_models_01 and the accepted standard inputs. The smooth/current Bott–Chern identification is proved by local potentials, partition of unity and elliptic regularity, without a global non-Kähler ddbar lemma. The Gauduchon functional, absence of opposite nonzero pseudoeffective classes, and Hopf de Rham-zero/BC-nonzero example are valid. Closedness is correctly required for the trace-class construction. The self-trace equality follows from the Bergman bound and the Jacobian integrability inequality a+A_E>m nu_E, including integer thresholds. Proper push–pull, Siu regular parts, additivity and nonnegative homogeneity are justified. Direct reading of DemAM11 lines 8360–8430, Theorem 14.12 on pp.142–143 and observation 14.14 confirms that unit ideals yield smooth approximants through the actual Bergman/cutoff gluing construction; bounded analytic type alone is not used to infer smoothness. Log resolution, divisor metrics and bounded residual potentials therefore give the claimed nef Cartier realization. Rational divisor coefficients agree with the manuscript's analytic-singularity convention. The Kähler comparison matches the supplied SGPT chapter and the author's [cohomological current construction](https://mingchenxia.github.io/Papers/TB.pdf). General nef approximation, volume and nonlinear mass questions remain unproved and are correctly left open. No critical errors or gaps were found.
